title: DOOM Eternal
provenance: community consensus (AppleGamingWiki / r-macgaming / MacPlay), unverified by Highball
notes: The game draws with Vulkan directly, through MoltenVK, so the graphics mode does not apply. On an M5 Pro with macOS 27.3 and engine x64-crossover26.3-r29 (highball#666, 2026-11-06) the launcher starts, and Play DOOM Eternal stops at the game's GPU check in every mode. Earlier community reports were mixed and are not measured here.

knownIssues.symptom: Play DOOM Eternal stops with _gpu_validation.reason_vendor_not_recon, "Unknown GPU vendor Apple M5 Pro" (highball#666).
knownIssues.cause: The game checks the GPU's maker before it draws and accepts the PC makers it knows. MoltenVK reports Apple's vendor ID.
knownIssues.fix: none yet. Reporting another maker from MoltenVK is the likely route, not tried here.
